cells.gaps: The 62.2 per cent is of persons aged 5 and over able to use a computer; no source found gives the share of adults with basic digital skills.
cells.note: The digital promotion agency's 2024 household indicators give 62.2 per cent of persons aged 5 and over able to use a computer, a measured share. It is not a share of adults with basic digital skills, so not stage 5.
